ns2:course.label: Non-Honors Independent Study
ns2:course.description: Readings in selected fields in consultation with the instructor resulting in a 20-30 page paper. Prerequisite: Junior or senior standing pursuing a History major; written consent of instructor and History undergraduate advisor required.
